description: Use when someone asks how in-house lab or point-of-care results can be sent into a specific EHR, EMR, EPR, LIS or practice-management system, or whether a lab interface exists for it (e.g. athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, Epic, Oracle Health/Cerner, NextGen, Experity, Tebra/Kareo, SystmOne, EMIS Web, MEDITECH). Returns the route (HL7 v2, FHIR R4 or vendor API), how far that route is proven, what the practice must request from its vendor, and the guide link.

ehr.description: Record system name as the user wrote it.
